blocks.text: JUNK REMOVAL FAQ
Commercial Junk Removal in Markham — Frequently Raised, Clearly Answered

items.q: What does commercial junk removal cost in Markham?
a: Truck volume is the entire model: small pickups from $125, with every larger figure scaling from the space your load fills and confirmed in writing at your Markham property first. Labour, dismantling, elevator cycles, recycling and disposal fees all live inside the number — which cannot move once approved.

items.q: How do you handle retired IT and electronics?
a: As a built-in service, not an add-on. Computers, monitors, servers, printers, phones and mixed e-waste route to licensed electronics recyclers as standard, with documentation of the disposal available for your records. For a city that retires tech by the floor, it’s often the biggest part of the job.

items.q: Can you decommission a full office floor on a deadline?
a: That’s core work. We stage crews and trucks against your re-stack or lease date, dismantle workstations in place, cycle the freight elevator efficiently, and hand back broom-swept space — with multi-day scheduling for multi-floor projects and the volume pricing scaling transparently throughout.

items.q: Do you meet building and plaza requirements — COIs, dock rules, quiet hours?
a: Before arrival, yes. Certificates of insurance go to property management at booking, elevator and dock windows get reserved in advance, and crews follow each building’s routing and hours without supervision. Markham’s stricter towers are familiar territory.

items.q: Can restaurant and food-court equipment be removed without disrupting service?
a: Routinely. Kitchen lines, coolers, seating and fixtures clear before open, after close or between tenancy — scheduled to the plaza’s rules — so neighbouring units trade straight through. Equipment with resale or donation value gets sorted for a second life first.

items.q: How fast can a junk removal crew reach my Markham business?
a: Frequently the same day. Trucks cover Markham seven days a week from 6AM to 11PM, and morning calls to +1 647 922 5865 regularly convert to afternoon pickups. You’ll get today’s genuine availability, stated in plain terms.

items.q: Do you support recurring junk removal for Markham portfolios?
a: It’s our steadiest business line. Weekly, monthly or per-turnover schedules across offices, plazas and mixed portfolios run at unchanged volume rates, consolidated to one invoice, with a single contact who knows every site’s rules and codes.

items.q: Why are your junk removal rates 30–50% below the national brands?
a: No franchise royalty in the quote — that’s the structural difference. The big names remit a share of every Markham job to head office; we’re independent and local, so identical loads with identical insurance simply cost less, visit after visit.
